notes.title: Captive's Final Version
notes.notes:
Captive's Final Version is now live and playable, with minor bug fixes concerning one of the endings, and the removal of one of the achievements.

If you had 100% on the achievements before the removal, don't worry, you still have it.

All the bugs that couldn't be properly fixed were addressed at the pinned post "Known Bugs & Solutions", at the community hub's discussions tab.

It's been quite a journey, and i thank all of you who've supported me thus far. I hope the game has kept up with your expectations, and every positive review, kind message or post at the discussions tab fills me with joy.

I hope to see you soon in Samael, take care.

notes.title: Samael's Storepage Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, i'm here to announce that the storepage for Samael, which is the indirect sequel to Captive, has just been updated, including a first minutes video.

Please go check it out, i'm sure you'll find it very interesting, and wishlist the game if it gets your interest.

As always, thank you for your support.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1065910/Samael/

notes.title: Windowed Mode Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

As many of you asked for it, i've just patched a windowed mode for playing Captive, so i hope this makes the game even more enjoyable for all of you out there.

As always, thank you for your support, and expect updates on Samael later this month.

notes.title: Captive Update: A new hidden surprise
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Today i bring you a new update on Captive, with a new hidden scene that i hope you'll all enjoy, if you manage to find it.

We also have a sale going on so if you didn't play the game yet, or wanna gift it to someone, now is a great chance to do so!

As always, thank you all for your support and if you enjoy the game please leave your review on the store page, it really helps out!

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.notes:
Hey guys, how are you?

I've recently uploaded a new update that changes a few textboxes and changed the aspect ratio of the game to complete fullscreen.

I hope this little polish makes the experience even better!

My next game will be on Steam by April, so i guess i'll see you soon!

As always, thank you for your support.

notes.title: Captive Version 1.4 Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, today i bring you the version 1.4 update for Captive, which will be the final major update for now, as i plan on focusing on other projects that will soon come to Steam aswell, although i will still be fixing bugs so be sure to send me a report if you find any.

This update counts with:

-A complete graphical revamp with new animations and effects
-Screen filters by Fallen Angel Olivia
-New items
-A little more lore exposition
-Some map changes

As always, thank you for your support.

notes.title: Version 1.2 Major Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

With the 2018 Summer Sale in it's way, we are very glad to announce that Captive is receiving a major update right now.

This update counts with map changes, bug fixes, lag reduction and additional content in the game, we hope all the issues pointed in the reviews, or most of them, are, as of now, fixed.

As always, thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Bug Fixes / Lag Reduction
notes.notes:
Today's update counts with some improvements in the game FPS rate at some rooms, hopefully it will solve all of the stuttering issues some players were experiencing.

Also, some general bug fixes at the credits screen were done, and now it looks like it's supposed to do.

notes.title: Captive 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
A new game build was just released, and it counts with many improvements:

-Achievements are now live and working
-Lag reduction
-Removal of unnecessary text boxes
-General bug fixes

notes.title: Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.

We are very proud to announce Dead Inside Studio's first full game release on Steam: Captive

Captive is a short horror game made in RPG Maker MV, inspired by the "escape the room" games that were very popular in the early 2000s, and, for that reason, we've set a small price for it.

It's a short game for a small price, keeping that in mind, we hope you all enjoy it and have fun.

Also follow our website updates and our Facebook page to keep up with the game release.

https://www.deadinsidestudio.com/

https://www.facebook.com/deadinsidestudio/


Thank you all for your support.
